author: HamMattress
quote: I have never played a GTA game and wanted to see what the hype was about especially after critics gave it 100 best game of all time... man were they wrong again. I am so bored after 10 hours, I can somewhat see why people like these games but the movement is janky, the driving is some of the worst handling of vehicles i have seen in a video game, I'm constantly swerving and doing doughnuts and i have seen this sentiment of boring gameplay and it not being great from everyone else online as seen by the metacritic of users. I dont know if other GTA games are much better but this is definitely not a masterpiece, its not even the best game of the year (although we all know it will win because of how big sellouts the game awards are). Very Very dissapointed and very boring, would not recommend playing, keep your money, i wish i could get a refund.

author: HamMattress
quote:
There are 2 groups of people. Those who love the classic and older episodes of South Park (up to season 10 or so) and hate the new ones and those who haven't watched the older episode and love the new ones. If you are not the latter then you will not like this game. If you are expecting the bigger and better format of sequels with more areas, improved game play and better story then you will be disappointed. What the SOT did with its outrageous story moments, varied areas and fun exploration has now been squashed in this game. There's no pushing of the boundaries of censorship like the space ship scene of SOT or the abortion or the hilarious fighting of the underpants gnomes whilst avoiding the flying genitalia of people having sex. It feels as though the creators gave in and kept this very appropriate making it a much duller experience. You can't go from hilarious and outrageous and then tone it down and expect a better experience.

As mentioned theres no story plots pertaining to 8 bit canada or the sewers with mr hankey nor the spaceship whilst being abducted by aliens, instead the entire game is contained to the same south park we saw in the original without any new or interesting areas and since we have already explored the exact same thing in the first game this instantly becomes a chore having to walk around the town again like nothing is new. Why didn't they introduce new exciting story areas like a story arc relating to imagination land or going to heaven and hell and fighting with the devil. What could have been a great opportunity to expand the universe by having the characters leave the town of southpark in crazy story arcs to keep it interesting was ultimately forgone for the same location we had before. Which makes me think why it took so many delays as the town and a lot of game components would have been copy paste from SOT. Why not push the boundaries a bit and expand the world.

In terms of story instead of having interesting, funny arcs where you would spend an hour on the spaceship or in the sewers they opted for an extremely lazy style of quests which was - introduce characters for brief moment, now you have to fight them for no reason. They did this so many times i lost count where they would introduce a character from the show like towlie or butters dad or the woodland critters and within seconds there was some stupid excuse for them fighting you. Its almost as if the creators were so proud of their new combat system that they decided to disregard any plot or extended cutscenes just to keep getting the player in combat situations. Its ok to have longer scenes where I can sit back and watch for a few minutes and feel like im watching the show. If this line of thinking was in the SOT you would probably go to the sewers meet mr hankey and have him say "hey get out of my sewers" (engage in combat) and then never see him again in the game. This got so tedious and boring especially since the combat because extremely dull which i will get into after this that I just felt is was trudging along for the sake of it.

As mentioned previously this game is very much catered to the newer audience of the show which personally I hate. South parks classic characters and comedy style which occupied most of the first game have been replaced with the newer characters who I absolutely cannot stand. What they did with the old episodes were have a character for an episode or 2 every few seasons (say mr hankey) and you loved the character in the newer episodes you have 20 episodes of PC principal in a row and he is such a dull and boring character and the joke wears off super quickly. Unfortunately this game has all of these newer characters and very little of the older ones and as such the player base is split. Everyone likes the older episodes and characters its what we grew to love thats why SOT worked. This game only works half the time for this reason.

And lastly the combat - no weapons this time, no stats on armour or weapons, no upgrading of this kind, no equiping of badges onto weapons and armour - all this customization is gone for abilities by choosing a class - which then leads to unlocking all of them anyway so there goes replay ability and intrigue. Then theres no skill to combat like blocking or hitting, instead theres no risk of missing a block and you hit everything regardless you will just do a bit less damage. Many times in the game i glitched out in combat or had to reset because the game bugged out from the shotty mechanics of being blocked on movements etc. And this coupled with them shoving combat down your throat every 2 seconds got so old.

The only 2 redeeming moments in the game was the hilarious 40 seconds of cutscene with the gay fish (just because of its ridiculousness) and the mephisto cutscene. This is because they showed interesting and different areas than just the town and because it felt like the humour of the old show rather than newer episodes.
game_title: South Park: The Fractured But Whole
